tools.name: BentoPDF
tools.summary: Process PDF and image files locally in the browser.
tools.privacy: Files are processed in the browser; Trendy Tools does not upload them.
aiFeatures: Describe a PDF workflow in natural language.
Review the generated workflow before loading it.
guidance: PDF passwords are entered locally after AI planning and must never be sent to the provider.
AI creates a reviewed workflow proposal; it does not directly process files.

tools.name: IT-Tools
tools.summary: A local collection of everyday developer and data utilities.

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.summary: Transform, encode, encrypt, compress, and inspect data locally.

tools.name: Squoosh
tools.summary: Compress and convert images locally with visual quality controls.
tools.privacy: Images are processed in the browser.

tools.name: miniPaint
tools.summary: Edit images with layers, selections, filters, and effects in the browser.
tools.privacy: Image editing runs locally in the browser.

tools.name: FreeCut
tools.summary: Edit video locally with a browser-native non-linear timeline.
guidance: The tool requires cross-origin isolation for some WebAssembly and media features.

tools.name: Omniclip
tools.summary: A local-first video editing workspace using modern browser media APIs.
tools.privacy: Media processing is designed to run locally in the browser.
guidance: The route requires cross-origin isolation for WebCodecs and worker features.

tools.name: Excalidraw
tools.summary: Create hand-drawn diagrams, wireframes, and visual notes locally.
tools.privacy: The hosted Trendy Tools route is a browser application.

tools.name: D2 Playground
tools.summary: Create technical diagrams from plain-text D2 source code.
tools.privacy: Diagram rendering runs in the browser.
aiFeatures: Describe a diagram in natural language and load generated D2 source after review.
guidance: AI-generated D2 is inserted into the editor for review; it does not silently publish or execute external content.

tools.name: JupyterLite
tools.summary: Run Python notebooks in the browser through WebAssembly.
tools.privacy: Python execution runs in the browser.

tools.name: OpenQR
tools.summary: Create styled QR codes for common links, contact, and device-sharing data.
tools.privacy: QR generation runs in the browser.

tools.name: Decimen
tools.summary: Transfer files between devices through animated QR codes.
capabilities: encode files into animated QR frames
scan QR frames with a camera
tools.privacy: File transfer is browser-local and does not require a server relay.

tools.name: KeeWeb
tools.summary: Open and manage local KeePass/KDBX password vaults in the browser.
tools.privacy: Vault access is browser-local; keep master passwords private.
guidance: Do not send vault contents or master passwords to the dashboard AI chat.

tools.name: Bolo
tools.summary: Record screen, webcam, and microphone input with local transcription support.
tools.privacy: Recording and transcription are designed for browser-local use.
guidance: The browser requires explicit permission before recording screen, camera, or microphone.
